## What and why


## Definition of done
- [ ] Tests written first and seen failing (or a reason why not)
- [ ] Green in CI; anything with maths matches the golden files in `packages/contracts/`
- [ ] Runs on both phones via TestFlight (app changes)
- [ ] Reviewed by the other person
- [ ] Demo note or screenshot posted on the issue

## Accuracy rules still hold
- [ ] Numbers only from the database or deterministic code; AI never writes a number
- [ ] Missing is unknown, never zero; totals show coverage
- [ ] Every log entry keeps its nutrition snapshot
- [ ] Source and verified status shown for products
- [ ] Logging never blocks
